title: Local Android builds replace CI installs
note: tool/ship.sh now gives local Android builds a version code far above CI's (2001), so `tool/ship.sh quando android` installs over the CI app instead of failing as a downgrade.
details: Use quando-pr10 (main) for builds. Apps: Quando? = com.dendrito.alarmapp, Matai? = com.dendrito.quando.kodesh, Quando Mine = com.dendrito.quando.mine.
